autonomy_levels.name: hypothesis_approval
autonomy_levels.operator_gate: Human approves each hypothesis before design or execution.

autonomy_levels.name: charter_approval
autonomy_levels.operator_gate: Human approves the experiment charter; execution may proceed autonomously within the charter.

autonomy_levels.name: goal_and_budget
autonomy_levels.operator_gate: Human sets the goal, domain scope, and resource budget; the agent may run the research loop within those limits.

autonomy_levels.name: full_autonomy
autonomy_levels.operator_gate: Full autonomous research loop. Promotion, live trading, deployment, and legal or financial decisions still require separate approval.

requires_operator_approval: investment, legal, tax, or financial advice
